taskContracts.objective: Define P81 business build orchestration contracts and safety boundary without enabling runtime execution.

inputs.narrowScope: Add P81 contracts, execution plan checker, docs, roadmap/status entries, and generated evidence only.
safetyRules: Do not enable provider calls, autonomous provider Q&A, PRD generation execution, agent dispatch, tool execution, worker execution, project mutation, DB writes, network calls, deploy, release, export, package creation, auth/session/user/workspace mutation, or provider spend. Require operator approval, scope boundary, budget limit, rollback plan, activity evidence, cost evidence, and redaction checks before any later execution-consuming phase.

reuseCheck.rule: Reuse existing report, metadata, result envelope, mode guard, redaction, checker formatter, phase status, Command Center route/card/tab, evidence, activity, audit, cost, and founder intake helpers; do not duplicate helpers.

inputs.commandCenterUxRequirements: Command Center UX must show current state, next action, blockers, disabled reason, owner capability, evidence/activity location, and cost impact without raw JSON, raw logs, DemoApp, internal phase labels outside OS Roadmap, or raw private project IDs.
playwrightTests: No Playwright route change unless Command Center UX changes in this subphase.
checkerUpdates: Register package script and add P81 phase IDs to OS phase status checker.
docsRoadmap: Update P81 plan, platform roadmap, OS roadmap, phase status, and generated reports.
inputs.phaseStatusUpdate: Mark P81 in_progress, mark P81.1 complete after validation, and set nextPhase to P81.2.

dataShapes: phaseId, scopeClassification, exactFilesModules, validationCommands, finalSafetyChecks, nextPhase

finalSafetyChecks: Confirm no DemoApp or raw private project IDs appear in primary UX.
gitCommands: git commit -m "docs(nexus): add business build orchestration contracts"

acceptanceCriteria: P81 has implementation-grade contracts for seven subphases.
No PRD generation, agent dispatch, project mutation, deploy, or provider spend is enabled.
